sourceChecks.title: Rapid and longer-term antidepressant effects of repeated ketamine infusions in treatment-resistant major depression
sourceChecks.excerpt: median time to relapse ... was 18 days
sourceChecks.paraphrase: An open-label 24-person TRD study found rapid improvement during repeated ketamine infusions, but median relapse time among responders was 18 days after the final infusion.
sourceChecks.limitations: Not a full remission in hours lasting years; open-label, small, treatment-resistant cohort and limited durability.

sourceChecks.title: Early intervention may prevent the development of posttraumatic stress disorder: a randomized pilot civilian study with modified prolonged exposure
sourceChecks.excerpt: lower PTSR ... at 4 weeks ... and at 12 weeks
sourceChecks.paraphrase: A 137-person randomized pilot reported reduced posttraumatic stress reaction scores at 4 and 12 weeks after immediate modified prolonged-exposure intervention.
sourceChecks.limitations: A small behavioral pilot reporting symptom scores does not establish universal PTSD prevention or a biological blocking intervention.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: PTSD prevention immediately after trauma randomized trial primary study

sourceChecks.title: The Cognitive and Negative Symptoms in Schizophrenia Trial (CONSIST): the efficacy of glutamatergic agents for negative symptoms and cognitive impairments
sourceChecks.excerpt: neither glycine nor D-cycloserine is a generally effective therapeutic option
sourceChecks.paraphrase: The 157-person 16-week randomized trial found no significant overall negative-symptom or cognition difference for adjunctive glycine or D-cycloserine versus placebo.
sourceChecks.limitations: This null trial is limited to these drugs and endpoints; it neither identifies nor excludes every curative pathophysiology-targeted treatment.
